rawSources.locator: OpenStax A&P 2e section 23.6: L31 organ roles; L35/L39 liver metabolism; L45-L46 bile ducts; L52-L58 bile/between-meal storage; L64-L68 pancreas; L79-L83 gallbladder.

literal.prompt: Какой орган накапливает и концентрирует желчь?

literalGroups.primaryGround: The MAIN fact asks which organ stores and concentrates bile; choices are digestive organs or related structures. OpenStax distinguishes liver bile production, gallbladder storage/concentration/release, pancreatic juice, and duodenal receipt of bile and pancreatic juice.

literalGroups.literal: Жёлчный пузырь хранит и концентрирует желчь, произведённую печенью. После еды он выделяет её в тонкую кишку.
literalGroups.primaryGround: The gallbladder stores and concentrates liver-produced bile and propels it into the duodenum when stimulated. OpenStax states these roles and describes bile diversion to the gallbladder between meals.

literalGroups.literal: Жёлчный пузырь хранит и концентрирует желчь между приёмами пищи.
literalGroups.primaryGround: The gallbladder stores and concentrates bile between meals. OpenStax says bile is diverted there, concentrated and stored until the next meal.

literalGroups.literal: Печень вырабатывает желчь и участвует в обмене питательных веществ.
literalGroups.primaryGround: The liver produces bile and has metabolic roles; OpenStax identifies bile production and processing of bloodborne nutrients.

literalGroups.literal: Поджелудочная железа выделяет пищеварительный сок, а её островки вырабатывают инсулин.
literalGroups.primaryGround: The pancreas releases digestive enzymes and hormones; OpenStax describes pancreatic juice, enzymes and insulin production by islets.

literalGroups.literal: Двенадцатиперстная кишка принимает желчь и сок поджелудочной железы.
literalGroups.primaryGround: The duodenum receives bile and pancreatic juice; OpenStax states both arrive there and describes the common opening into the duodenum.

absoluteDifficulty.audienceGround: Identifying which digestive organ stores and concentrates bile requires familiarity with digestive anatomy; it is not broad everyday knowledge for all adults.
absoluteDifficulty.reasoningGround: The four options have related digestive roles and distinguishable functions. The key requires knowing the storage role, not specialist terminology or a multistep calculation.
